newsitem.title: USA: Global Industrial, Siam Cement in venture.
newsitem.headline: Global Industrial, Siam Cement in venture.

text.p: Global Industrial Technologies Inc said Thursday its Harbison-Walker Refractories division has begun a joint venture with the Siam Cement Group to develop, build and operate refractory plants throughout Southeast Asia.

Global Industrial said the two companies will be equal partners in these plants, each of which are expected to require a total investment of between $40 million and $50 million, and generate annual revenue of between $50 million and $60 million.

The company said that the demand for refractories products in Southeast Asia is expected to double to about $800 million by 2005, and it expects to capture a significant share of the future growth for the shareholders' benefit.

Global Industrial Technologies is a manufacturer of technologically advanced industrial products that support high-growth markets worldwide. Siam Cement, said the company, is a conglomerate with 1996 revenues of $7 billion.
